prompt: I'm about to share this architecture diagram with my team — before I do, can you check it against diagram conventions? Lint everything: metadata, naming, line labels, legend, abstraction levels, whatever you can find. File: .../fixtures/messy_architecture.drawio

assertions.text: Flags the 'New Shape' placeholder label as an issue
Identifies the dangling edge pointing to a deleted node (n-deleted-long-ago) and/or the floating edge with no endpoints
Reports that the edges are unlabeled (all 5 have no labels)
Flags the absence of a legend despite 3+ distinct fill colors used meaningfully
Flags metadata inconsistency: key drift (technology vs tech) and/or owner attribute on only one node
Identifies abstraction-level mixing: the Customer actor alongside an API Gateway container with internal components (Request Router, token validator)
Flags naming drift: 'auth-service' / 'token validator' lowercase vs Title Case labels
Report includes concrete, actionable fix suggestions rather than just listing problems
